entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: We are amused to hear such submission as in a crime of heinous nature, under the special Statute, the police have shown over zealousness in submitting the charge-sheet without arresting the accused.
It further appears that concerned police station has taken no pains to trace the accused.

It is H. C. Shiv 26.w118.24.doc the contention of the Petitioner that, the accused is sending her photographs along with the victim and also threatening her to withdraw the case.

sentences.text: According to us, undoubtedly, it is a matter of very serious concern.
We therefore direct the Joint Commissioner of Police (Crimes), Pune to file his detailed reply to the Petition.

We expect from the concerned Officer to verify whether the Investigating Officer in C.R.No.488 of 2023, has complied with necessary provisions of Cr.P.C. and the law of land as enunciated in that behalf by the Hon'ble Supreme Court under Article 141 of the Constitution of India.
4) We direct the Joint Commissioner of Police (Crimes) not to delegate his powers to any subordinate Officer while filing such an affidavit.

We further direct the Joint Commissioner of Police (Crimes) to place on record, in how many cases under the POCSO Act within jurisdiction of Pune Police Commissionerate, charge-sheets have been filed without arresting the accused persons in an offence under the provisions of POCSO Act.

4.1)
This be done on or before 24th January, 2024.
5) Stand over to 25th January, 2024.

(SHYAM C. CHANDAK,J.) (A. S. GADKARI, J.)
